subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, or adopt/refresh one of the conflicting fork candidates for this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but duplicate closed PRs plus conflicting fork candidates mean automation should not open another branch until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue or author a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs as design context.

options.title: Refresh one fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require regression coverage plus real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep the issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue or author a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs as design context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path and release-line history make this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
